北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，注意温差，早晚添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and bright. Mind the temp difference, dress warmly in mornings/evenings!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷湿滑，体感更凉，记得多穿衣保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is damp and chilly, feels colder. Remember to dress warmly!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，体感舒适。出行带伞以防万一。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feels pleasant. Bring an umbrella just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感温暖。注意防潮，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid, feels warm. Mind the dampness and stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天不减暖意，湿度大。记得多补水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy but warm, with high humidity. Stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷湿润，体感较凉。多穿衣服，注意防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is damp and chilly, feels quite cool. Dress warmly and mind the humidity.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微冷，体感偏凉。出门别忘添衣哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and a bit cold, feels cooler. Don't forget to layer up when heading out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云暖和，体感舒适。注意防晒，多喝水！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy and warm, feels comfortable. Mind the sun and drink plenty of water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天湿冷，体感有些凉。记得及时添衣哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and damp, feels a bit cold. Remember to add layers promptly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阳光明媚，体感舒适。享受美好时光吧！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and bright, feels comfortable. Enjoy the lovely weather!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗温暖，体感舒适。多喝水保持活力！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and warm, feels pleasant. Drink water to stay energetic!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云天凉，体感冰冷。务必穿厚实保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and chilly, feels freezing. Make sure to dress very warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴空万里，注意温差。体感偏凉，记得添衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and bright. Mind the temp change, feels cool, remember to layer up.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天宜人，体感舒适。空气干燥，多补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasant, feels comfortable. Air is dry, stay hydrated.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天闷热，湿度很大。多喝水，注意防晒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and muggy with high humidity. Drink water, mind the sun!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云微凉，体感稍冷。出门记得多穿一件。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy and cool, feels a bit cold. Remember to layer up when going out.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云偏冷，体感凉意浓。出门添衣保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy and cool, feels quite chilly. Layer up to stay warm!
